hanoi-ha-giang-limestone-loop-stage.title: Hanoi · Ha Giang Limestone Loop Stage
hanoi-ha-giang-limestone-loop-stage.slogan: Two passes and 416 km, high point 1500 m
hanoi-ha-giang-limestone-loop-stage.story: Limestone drama and a route that is never casual. Out of Hà Giang and back again: 416 km, roughly 8 h in the saddle. The climbs: Quan Ba Heaven and Ma Pi Leng Pass. It tops out at about 1,500 m. The passes are the reason to go.

places-friso-de-los-gitanos-o-abrigo-del.story: 177 km from Nerpio to Nerpio, about 3 h 03 of riding. It goes by way of Abrigo del molino de Bagil, Cueva de las Palamas, Abrigo del milano and back through Cueva de las Palamas. The highest point is about 1,350 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 25 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-the-maritime-channel-vyborgskaya-.story: From Kronstadt it runs 150 km to Kronstadt; allow about 2 h 35 of riding. The stops in between: Gostilitskoe Highway, Petrovsky, Vyborgskaya Road and back through Petrovsky. The line favours views over speed.
